{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# Do NOT filter out -999 at this stage — include all patients, even those with QC failure
# This ensures we count all enrolled patients

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of unique patients
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Print the result
print(num_patients)"}
